issues.what: The race payoff is clipped. The ScannerProp's tray, which should show the passport with grey missing bands, sits about 60% outside the bottom-right edge. Its visible part is about x 1740-1920, y 840-1080 at 1080p (f6574, f6604), which is also inside the bottom 140 px. The passport is about 50 px tall and the bands can't be read. The copy-out rebuild has the same problem: at 5660-5680 the tray photo is about 50 px and cut by the right edge.
issues.fix: Move the scanner up and left so the whole tray sits inside x<=1856, y<=940 at >=240 px wide. Or insert a 20-30 f tray close-up on 'chance to lose it' (6605-6640) showing the banded passport before the wall exit.

issues.what: 'Recovery is a race' plays as a recap. No write lands during 'every write to that drive is a chance to lose it': all three hits already landed at 6128-6184. The beam dwells on the bottom run, the tally doesn't change, and a static coral bracket is the only coral (f6544-6634).
issues.fix: Follow DIRECTION §8 S4: on 'every write' (6554) and 'chance' (6610), drop 1-2 coral writes ahead of the moving beam onto still-lit photo boxes. Add a 6 f coral ring and a tally notch pulse per write.

issues.what: The hardware-stage scanner is one 7 s composition. The scanner fills about 40% of the frame width on an empty dark stage, and the 30-f sheet frames 5194-5374 look nearly identical. The only changes are a small beam (5236), a sweep (5276) and the card sliding onto the plate (5336).
issues.fix: Add a slow orbit/push toward the plate from 5276, and cut or push closer when the struck card lands on 'deleted file' (5336), so the image changes about every 3 s.

method: Decoded frames only; no playback and no audio. Read PLAYBOOK §4-§8, DIRECTION (all of it), TRANSCRIPT P08-P15, ledger rows C08-C14, and the S4/S5/S6 plans. Render logs S4-S7 contain 0 '[kit]' warnings. I extracted 5074-9965 (4,892 frames, count verified) and ran tools/static_check.py --offset 5074: 0 frozen stretches at the default 0.35 threshold and also at 1.0, and 0 empty frames. I used 13 images in all, from tools/sheet.py on out/ep06/v1/ep06_film.mp4 with absolute frames: three overview sheets every 30 f (S4 52, S5 59, S6 52 frames, width 320); three native 960 px detail sheets of 8 text-heavy frames each (S4, S5, S6); a boundary sheet (5096-5110, 6641-6655, 8396-8410 and 9922-9951 every 2 f); sync sheets for S4 (56 frames) and S6 (60 frames) at the word frames; a mixed sheet (SSD dive 7141-7185, refusal 7295-7328, sweep and scanner launch 8716-8800, sparse stage 9728-9800); S5 beats (6885-7100, 7612-7764, 8104-8300); trays, split opening and multiply (5640-5680, 6590-6640, 8556-8660, 9064-9112); quote zoom, group erase and verdict hold (5390-5502, 7376-7600, 8960-9060); and one side-by-side of f8756 and f7712. I also measured without images: cap heights from connected components of bright pixels on half-scale crops (about 20 text elements), per-30-row luma mean and std on 20 frames (black top band, near-empty stage, empty bottom band of the split), and coral and white pixel onset tracking (strike starts at 6896 on 'Windows', tab around 6964-6984). No full-res stills were rendered; every element checked against the floors passed except the QuoteStrip attribution, so none were needed. I can't verify determinism from frames; the Archive's ids and states are consistent across all three sections. Range score = section scores weighted by length (1545/1755/1531 f).
